title: Best OP Auto Cook Auto Serve Auto Hire Auto Expand
features:
Ronix Hub - Karinderya

Auto
- Auto Assign NPC seats waiting customers at empty tables, with an interval slider
- Auto Cook picks up food from ready stoves and Auto Serve hands it to seated customers
- Auto Reject turns away runaway or raging customers, with Cook and Serve Interval sliders
- Live stats for customers assigned, served, cooked and rejected, your cash and total earned

Buy Ingredients
- Pick ingredients from a list and Auto Buy on a 5 to 300 second timer
- Auto Buy only spends cash you have, or press Buy Ingredients Now for a single round

Furniture
- Pick tables, chairs and stoves from the shop, Auto Buy or Buy Furniture Now

Counter Upgrades
- Refresh Counter Info and Buy Upgrade for your next counter upgrade

Hire and Manage
- Auto Hire Workers with a check interval, or Hire First Worker by hand
- Roll Worker Now button, and Refresh Workers to see how many are waiting to be hired

Merchant
- Pick merchant items, Auto Buy on a refresh timer, Buy Now and Refresh Stock

Plot Expansion
- Auto Expand buys your target once you can afford it, or use Expand Now

Anti-Disaster
- Anti-AFK, Anti Runaway with a Chase Distance slider, Hit Nearest Runaway

Quick Teleport
- Home, Shop and Grocery teleport buttons

Redeem Codes
- Type codes in and Redeem All, plus Claim Group Reward and Auto Claim Group

Performance
- Low Graphics toggle, and an Info tab with your build and game IDs

Mobile friendly. Join discord.gg/ronixstudios for support and updates.
